newsitem.title: GERMANY: Georgia forecasts 400,000T wheat crop -German DBV.
newsitem.headline: Georgia forecasts 400,000T wheat crop -German DBV.

text.p: Ex-Soviet Georgia is forecasting a wheat crop of 400,000 tonnes for 1997, it said in official correspondence with the German farmers' union (DBV).
DBV published the figure in a weekly circular, citing the agriculture ministry in Tbilisi and adding the corresponding 1996 harvest figure was 177,000 tonnes.

The information obtained from Georgia also said self sufficiency in grain would rise to 55 percent in 1997 from 10 percent in recent years, but it was planned to increase yields even more to cut import costs.

Georgia had obtained the equivalent of 14 million marks in European Union partnership fund credits to buy seeds, fertiliser, pesticides, fuel and spare parts. It planned to spend 16 to 21 million marks on wheat imports in 1997.
An agriculture ministry offical in Tbilisi on June 23 estimated the wheat crop at 304,154 tonnes.
